BiblicalUsage: Hazar-enon, the village of springs, is named in Ezekiel's vision as a point on the northern border, the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath. It is the same border town as Hazar-enan under a slightly different spelling.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God names the springs on the border of the promised land, and the vision of the new boundaries is as exact as the old ones.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
